Inspect the codebase and relevant specs to find one meaningful behavior that lacks a focused unit test. Keep the work small: inspect no more than six directly related implementation and test files, and add or update at most two test files.

Add tests only. Do not change production code, configuration, documentation, or generated files. Prefer tests for user-visible or public behavior over implementation details. Do not add tests for speculative edge cases or duplicate existing coverage. Follow the repository's test conventions and `AGENTS.md` rules.

If you cannot identify a concrete coverage gap that can be tested without production changes, leave the repository unchanged. Dependencies are installed before this prompt runs. During implementation, run the directly related unit test file(s) and lint changed test files. Fix failures and rerun those focused checks before finishing. Do not run the full `pnpm check`; the workflow runs it as an independent final gate. Do not install dependencies or claim checks passed unless you actually ran them. Review the final diff to confirm it contains only focused tests and has no obvious lint or type errors. Do not commit or push.
